description:
Trained on 58 images from the Type C dataset. This data was collected based on similar eye types. Compared to Type A and B, the eyes are more round and more slender. The base for this lora is Illustrious-XL 0.1.

I've tried many times to create this lora on Pony, but it always came out poorly. It wasn't until illustrious came along and I adjusted my settings, where I was able to get acceptable results.

Due to the dataset, you might end up getting pointy_ears unprompted, simply put this in the negative if that happens.

You should be able to use any illustrious based model with this lora, I haven't tested it on noob. I personal recommend you use Zootlustrious. The model is already 2d but using this lora will enhance the style as well as the wonderful backgrounds.

Yes I know the size is bigger than my other loras, it was a result of the setting changes with my training. No, I don't plan to make a smaller version.
